main_text.p: גור Ch. Catulus, Genef.49.9. in T.Jon. & Hierofol. מְגִירָא, מְגִיר Ch. Vicinus, Cohabitator. Plural. מְגִירִין, מְגִירָיא.
גֵּן, גּוָא Ch. Nomen avis immundae: בַּר גּוָא Levit. 11. 13. & Deuter. 14.12. in T.Jon. respondet Hebraeo עֲוֹנָיָה, Haliaeetus.

גזא Syr. Gaza, Thesaurus. Deinde quoque est nomē proprium urbis, Gaza, Act.8.26.27. Mar. 12.41. Convenit cum גְּנָזָא Chald. Scribunt communiter vocem esse Persicam. In Targum Persico Tavasii similem vocem reperio Hebraeae אוֹצָר respondentem, ut Deut.28.12. pro את אוצרו: Persice מר כוזיי אֵי Thesaurum suum, quod absolute, ni fallor, esset כְּזִיָּא; (Nomina enim sequetibus pronominibus, syllabam אִי vel יִ solent assumere) quod si ר & נ transponantur, & כ permutetur in ג, fiet גְּנִיזָא Chald. In Plur. מן דר כְּזִינָהִי In Thesauris meis, Deut.32.34. Sic Turcae Thesaurum vocant Chasna.
גזבר Ch.Quaestor, Praefectus aerario, Esrae 1.8. Plur.emph. גְּזַבְּרַיָּא cap.7.21.
גזה Pahel Partic. מְגַזֵּא Dolat, Jesa.44.13.
גזירת Ch. Caesio, Lapis caesus & politus, Esth.4.1. in Targ. secundo.
גזז Chal. Tondere, Detondere: Incidere, Pehil דְּגַזִּיז Quae incisa est, vel arrosa, Psalm.72.6. Ithpehal אִתְגַּזַּז Detonderi, Abscindi, Amos 7.1.
גזז Chald. גָּזָּא Syr. Tonsor, Act. 8.32. Plural. גַּזָּזִין Tonsores.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-like vocalised forms transcribed approximately; marginal and small Syriac/Hebrew points not fully reliable. The catchword at the lower right reads גזא.
